summary: Rebased local main onto the latest upstream main from spear-sim/spear without pushing or opening a PR. Dirty working tree changes were preserved with a reversible stash, restored successfully, and no stash remains.
work_completed: Initial state inspected: current branch main tracked origin/main and was ahead 8 with dirty working tree changes present.
Identified origin as fork https://github.com/yashturkar/spear and upstream parent as https://github.com/spear-sim/spear.git with default branch main via GitHub repository metadata.
Added upstream remote and fetched upstream/main at b482514a54109126faa3c98566b434d3a2291621.
Saved dirty tracked and untracked working tree changes with stash message 'git-master pre-rebase 2026-06-25T15:53Z'.
Rebased main onto upstream/main using standard git rebase; 15 non-merge local commits were replayed and prior merge commits were flattened by the rebase.
Resolved one rebase conflict in .gitignore by preserving the upstream ignore list and adding the local flashlight ignore entries.
Restored preserved working tree changes with git stash pop; stash f1b6bacb4f7fc930310b6a1ccab93e4133fd46ca was dropped after successful restore.

Final branch state: main at 41b92d5189092d9bd9f0dcd046f6a827d38f603a; relative to upstream/main it is ahead 15, behind 0. Relative to origin/main it is ahead 44, behind 9 because the rewritten branch was not pushed.

findings.message: No push was performed and no PR was opened.
No rebase state remains; .git/rebase-merge and .git/rebase-apply are absent.
Working tree remains dirty as it was before the operation: 19 modified tracked files and 123 untracked files are present after stash restoration.
Local main now diverges from origin/main by 44 ahead and 9 behind due to rebasing onto upstream/main without pushing the rewritten branch.

follow_up_recommendations: Review the rebased history and dirty working tree before any future push.
If this fork should publish the rebased main, push only after explicit approval and use the repository's preferred safe force-with-lease workflow if rewriting origin/main is intended.
